description_zh: 查询时间中心的历史事件
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-history-events-stat --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-id adb --archive-status All --from-start-time 2022-01-02T11:31:03Z --to-start-time 2022-03-02T11:31:03Z --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHistoryEventsStat

parameters.help_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:

Archived
UnArchived
All
parameters.help_zh:
事件状态。取值说明：

Archived：已归档

UnArchived：未归档

All：所有
parameters.name: archive_status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time later than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The start time can be up to 30 days earlier than the current time. If you set this parameter to a time more than 30 days earlier than the current time, this time is automatically converted to a time that is exactly 30 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之后的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。最早支持 30 天前，距当前时间超过 30 天会自动转换成 30 天前
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time earlier than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之前的任务。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC +0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time
